pins.move: grep -rlE 'companygraph/mcp-server[^[:space:]"]*(@|\?ref=)v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' .github/workflows infra | xargs perl -pi -e 's~(companygraph/mcp-server[^\s"]*?(?:@|\?ref=))v\d+\.\d+\.\d+~${1}{version}~g' && perl -pi -e 'BEGIN{($v="{version}")=~s/^v//} s~("\@companygraph/mcp-server"\s*:\s*")\d+\.\d+\.\d+~${1}$v~' package.json && npm install

grep -rlE 'companygraph/chat-server[^[:space:]"]*(@|\?ref=)v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' .github/workflows infra | xargs perl -pi -e 's~(companygraph/chat-server[^\s"]*?(?:@|\?ref=))v\d+\.\d+\.\d+~${1}{version}~g' && perl -pi -e 'BEGIN{($v="{version}")=~s/^v//} s~("\@companygraph/chat-server"\s*:\s*")\d+\.\d+\.\d+~${1}$v~' chat/package.json && npm install --prefix chat

verify: GITHUB_TOKEN=${GITHUB_TOKEN:-$(gh auth token)} npm run snapshot
